ui.label: Authors
ui.description: Public author profiles shown on bylines and author pages (E-E-A-T). Public fields only: nothing here is an account, contact or ERP field.

ui.label: Display name
ui.help: The name as it is printed on the byline. A real person's name, never a role such as 'Editorial team'.

ui.label: Role / title
ui.help: Public job title, for example 'Head of SEO'.

ui.label: Short bio
ui.help: Two to four sentences in the third person. Only what the person agreed to publish.

ui.label: Expertise topics
ui.help: Short topic names, for example 'Technical SEO'. One per entry.

ui.label: Credentials
ui.help: Free text, one per entry: qualifications, certifications, years of experience. Only claims that can be verified.

ui.label: Photo
ui.help: A media item. Only with the person's consent.

ui.label: Photo alt text
ui.help: Describes the photo for screen readers. Required whenever a photo is set.

ui.label: Public profile links
ui.help: Public pages about this person (LinkedIn, personal site, ORCID ...). https URLs only; the editor and the importer enforce it.

ui.label: Link text
ui.help: Optional visible text; falls back to the network name.

ui.label: Show on the site
ui.help: false hides the profile and its byline link without deleting the record. Needs the person's profile consent.
